description: Offline news fixtures written for this agent. They are not wire copy and not company announcements. source_type is fixture and the URL scheme is fixture://.

articles.title: Pilgangoora 辉石精矿按周计划装船
articles.body: Pilbara 的 Pilgangoora 锂矿本周继续按计划向赫德兰港发运辉石精矿，选厂没有报告停机，港口库存处于常态区间。此条为离线样本，不是公司公告。

articles.title: 2027 年精矿销售条款仍在谈
articles.body: Pilbara Pilgangoora 的 2027 年辉石精矿销售量仍在商谈。精矿结算价和氢氧化锂参考价不是同一个合约，不能直接对照。此条为离线样本，不是公司公告。

articles.title: Pilgangoora concentrate shipments stay on the weekly plan
articles.body: The sample desk notes that Pilbara Minerals' Pilgangoora operation loaded spodumene concentrate for Port Hedland this week without a reported plant stoppage. Port inventory was described as inside the usual band. This item is an offline fixture, not a company announcement.

articles.title: Spodumene offtake talks stay open as hydroxide prices drift
articles.body: Counterparties are still discussing 2027 offtake volumes for Pilgangoora spodumene. No suspension, force majeure, or heritage stoppage is included in this fixture. Concentrate pricing remains a different contract from any hydroxide reference quote.

articles.title: Pilbara tenement note mentions routine water monitoring
articles.body: A fixture note says the Pilgangoora site continued routine water monitoring. No spill volume is stated. The heritage survey timetable was not changed in this note.

articles.title: Older Pilgangoora drill note sits outside a one-day window
articles.body: This older fixture records a completed infill drilling week at Pilgangoora. It is kept so a wider lookback still has a citation, and it should not appear in a one-day briefing for 2026-10-27.

articles.title: Copper concentrate leaves a different camp
articles.body: A copper concentrate parcel left an unrelated camp. This fixture exists so a specialty-metal query does not match every item published on the same day.
